primary_model_diagnostics_24bps.hgbt: degenerate constant-like predictions; zero positive account actions

decision.reason: The economically readable continuation and fade actions were already negative in 2022 at realistic costs. Every ML account was negative or abstained, exact winner deletion worsened every traded policy, and model ranking/calibration did not beat simple constants. This is not a threshold or leverage problem.

known_limitations: Maximum drawdown in the fast discovery replay is measured on event-level account marks rather than complete minute-by-minute liquidation NAV; the negative decision does not depend on a tighter MDD estimate.
The complete local evaluator and action ledgers were not yet transported into this draft branch; the source exporter, fixed contract and compact decision evidence are present.
The result closes this exact synchronized-funding-differential formulation, not every possible cross-venue inventory signal.
